The main takeaway from our work is that
the integrin heterodimer is a molecular machine, and that it can undergo a series of structural rearrangements in response to ligand binding and other stimuli.
integrins are a complex family of heterodimeric receptors with multiple ligand binding and signaling sites that are regulated in a dynamic fashion.
integrin ligand binding and activation are not separate processes, and the two processes are coupled.
